name: player_rebuild_motion_basis_from_steer_basis
description: Player::RebuildMotionBasisFromSteerBasis rebuilds motionBasis from steerBasisRaw, steerBasisRef, their side cross product, and worldPos.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player hover/master-type orientation pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b970 validates basisSide = cross(steerBasisRaw, steerBasisRef), motionBasis X row from basisSide, Y row from steerBasisRef, Z row from -steerBasisRaw, and position from worldPos.
The native smoke verifies every motionBasis field for a nontrivial raw/reference/world-position input.
